title: DungeonTrials
description: Wave-based dungeon challenge with rewards and join system.
body:
# DungeonTrials

Wave-based dungeon challenge with rewards and join system.

## Features
- Configurable dungeon spawn and wave list.
- Join/leave system for participants.
- Reward items after final wave.
- Admin controls for start/stop.

## Command
- `/dungeon setspawn | join | leave | start | stop | status | reload`

## Permissions
- `dungeontrials.use`
- `dungeontrials.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
reward.material: DIAMOND
reward.amount: 2
waves.wave1.mobs:
  - ZOMBIE:6
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
